amendment_reason: The ready-made BF16 GGUF did not preserve the behavior of the previously tested Hugging Face checkpoint. To isolate CPU versus Radeon, v0.2 converts the exact cached checkpoint used by Gate 16B.1.
hypothesis: The exact unquantized BF16 Qwen3-8B checkpoint from Gate 16B.1 can run fully on yukabox's integrated Radeon through ROCm, preserve its 11/12 quality, and generate faster than its approximately 1.4 tokens per second CPU result.

input.source: The same two private cleaned Codex conversations and six questions used by Gate 16B.1

success.fit: All transformer layers are offloaded to ROCm without out-of-memory or host fallback.
success.quality: At least 11/12 manual points on the same six questions.
success.speed: Generated-token throughput is greater than 1.4 tokens per second.

boundary: This is one development run on one integrated GPU. The two failed v0.1 launch attempts remain part of the public record and are not scored as the isolated CPU-versus-Radeon comparison.
